shape: Partner-airline segment, outside what the agent may rebook
author: Sushant
message: My connection on LK9812 isn't going to work out. Just move me to the next flight today, I don't care which airline.
expect: Recognise the booking has a partner-airline segment, do not hold or rebook anything, escalate to a human with a summary, and tell the customer plainly that a person will handle it and why, without promising an outcome or a time.
